purpose: Second-round logo previews emphasizing protection, human help and support. Not applied to the app.

concepts.name: A — Safe Hands
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Design a new, exceptional logo for "Victim Voice", a women's safety, emergency help and ongoing support app. This is a second design round: the earlier concepts were too generic or abstract and did not clearly communicate safety PLUS human help. The new symbol must instantly suggest "someone will help protect and support me". Dignified, warm, professional and reassuring. A high-end identity designer's reductive mark, not clip art, not stock NGO art. Use a maximum of two carefully integrated visual ideas, a powerful silhouette and generous negative space. Crisp flat vector-like shapes, entirely SOLID colours: absolutely no gradients, shading, texture, gloss, bevel or 3D. Existing brand palette: deep plum #30253D, jade #2C6D5D, restrained coral #CB433C; warm ivory background #FBF7F2. Meaningful human protection, no helpless victim imagery, no female face profiles, lotus, flowers, raised-fist activism, chains, ribbons, police badges, medical crosses, locks or decorative wings. Keep any hands broad and abstract with minimal fingers so it remains recognisable at 32px. Create ONE square presentation board for ONE concept. Large refined symbol, comfortably spaced accurate wordmark "Victim Voice" underneath in a readable crafted humanist typeface. At the bottom a small app-icon rendering of the SAME symbol and a small monochrome rendering. Lots of whitespace and strong visual hierarchy. Exact text only "Victim Voice"; no slogans, extra copy or watermarks. The hero symbol must NOT be oversized relative to the wordmark. Consistent proportions in all three renderings.
Specific direction: Create two generous cupped hands that together form an unmistakable soft shield outline, sheltering a single simple upright human figure in the negative space. The hands ARE the shield; do not draw a separate shield behind them. Make a small coral head and a grounded jade protective form against ivory, plum wordmark. A clever, very clear protection-and-care mark, not a heart with extra objects pasted in. Broad geometric hand shapes with softly rounded ends, balanced open top, compact silhouette. A recognisable person safely supported by human hands should be the first read.
